title: Web exports with custom build templates don't work
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6 stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable (89cea1439) - Fedora Linux 43 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (radeonsi, gfx1201, LLVM 21.1.8, DRM 3.64, 6.18.8-200.fc43.x86_64) - AMD Ryzen 5 9600X 6-Core Processor (6 threads) - 30.42 GiB memory

### Issue description

I compiled a custom build template of the engine for a smaller build size for web releases. However, any kind of custom template, even if just compiled from the source with no additional arguments, leads to the exported build not starting after the loading bar has finished.
- Starting a local server with the serve.py _does work_, but it leaves a bunch of error messages in the debug console of the browser that do _not_ appear when building without a template.
- Uploading the custom build to Github pages will hinder the program from starting after the loading bar has finished. The same errors appear:

### Steps to reproduce

1. Download the source code for Godot 4.6 stable
2. Compile a release template with `scons platfrom=web target=template_release`
(no additional build profile needed)
3. create a new project with an empty scene
4. export with your new custom build template
5. start a local server or upload the files to Github pages

Scons version: 4.10.1-3
Emscription version: 5.0.0

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp-web-custom-template.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25139092/mrp-web-custom-template.zip)
includes empty scene and release_template file
